replies.author: Milki
replies.body:
The game is Touhou, a bullet hell game (meaning the point is to shoot enemies while avoid all other bullets.)

It's well known for being a particularly difficult game without good practice, and even then it's still difficult.

Generally, the only part of you that can be hit is a small pixel or circle of pixels (as shown as the red circle on the character  in Glitchy's video).
